collection.description: A skilled craftsperson makes an obvious error in front of their apprentices and becomes defensive.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (craftsperson), a skilled craftsperson, makes an obvious error in front of their apprentices and becomes defensive.

choices.label: Make a Gentle Joke Only If Welcome

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They initially refuse, then quietly correct the mistake themselves.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The apprentices appreciate seeing expertise coexist with fallibility.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (craftsperson) feels exposed and needs time before speaking again.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The silence is mistaken for disapproval until someone checks in.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The joke lands badly, and the speaker apologizes promptly.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: They return later with a repaired object and a small smile.
